paite: Huan mipite zak a athugen teng azohtak in Kapernaum ah alut a,
heading: Sepaih Zaheutu Sikha Hihdamna / (Mat 8.5-13)
english: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

paite: sepaih zaheutu kuahiam sikha deihtak a china in, asi dekdek hi.
english: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.

paite: Huchi in Jesu tanchin azaktak in asikha hong hihdam ding a ngen ding in akiang ah Juda upate asawl hi.
english: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.

paite: Amau Jesu kiang ava tung ua, limtak in angen uhi,
english: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,

paite: "Amah zaw na hihsak tak ahi; ka nam uh a-it a, ka sinagog uh leng ama hon lamsak ahi,” achi uhi.
english: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”

paite: Huchi in Jesu amau toh ahong pai hi. A-inn atun dek kuan in sepaih zaheutu'n alawmte asawl a, "Ka insung na lutna tak ahi kei,
english: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.

paite: huaiziak in na kiang a hong tak in leng ka kisim kei, thu leltak gen lechin, ka naupang adam mai ding.
english: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.

paite: Kei leng mi thunuai a om ka hi a, ka nuai ah sepaihte a-om ua; huai mipa, hiai mipa, 'Pai in,' ka chihleh apai a, midang kiang ah leng, 'Hong pai in,' ka chihleh ahong pai a; ka sikha kiang ah leng, hiai hih in, ka chih leh ahih zel," achi hi.
english: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

paite: Jesu'n huai thu azak in lamdang asa mahmah a, akihei a, mipi amah zuite kiang ah, "K'on hilh ahi, Israelte lak ah leng hichi tel a ginna thupi ka mu kha kei," achi hi.
english: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”

paite: Huan inn ah amisawlte apai nawn ua, damtak in sikha amuta uhi.
english: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.

paite: Huan sawt louchik in khua khat Nain kichi ah ahoh a; akiang ah anungzuite leh mipi tampitak ahoh sam uhi.
heading: Meithai Tapa Hihdamna
english: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.

paite: Khopi kongkhak kiang atun in, ngai in, misi ahon zawngkhia ua, anu tapa neihsun ahi a, amah lah meithai ahi ngal a; akhua mite tampi akiang ah a-om uhi.
english: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only born son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.

paite: Toupa'n meithainu amuh in, alainat mahmah a, "Kap ke'n," achi hi.
english: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her and said to her, “Don’t cry.”

paite: Huan ava naih a, lang ava len hi; huchi in lang zawngte akhawl uhi. "Tangval thou in, ka hon chi," achi hi.
english: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”

paite: Huan misi atukhia a, ahong pauta hi. Huchi in Jesu'n anu kiang ah apeta hi.
english: He who was dead sat up and began to speak. Then he gave him to his mother.

paite: Huan mi tengteng in alau ua, Pathian aphat ua, "I lak ah zawlnei thupi ahong suakta, achi ua, Pathian in amite hong vehta," achi uhi.
english: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”

paite: Huan huai mi tungtang thu Judia gam tengteng leh akiang vel gam teng ah athangkheta hi.
english: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea and in all the surrounding region.

paite: Huan Johan nungzuite'n huai thu tengteng Johan ahilh uhi.
heading: Baptispa Johan Misawlte / (Mat 11.2-19)
english: The disciples of John told him about all these things.

paite: Huchi in Johan in anungzuite nih asam a, Toupa kiang ah asawl a, "Hong pai dingpa na hi hia, midang hungaih lailai ding ka hi uhia?” chi in.
english: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”

paite: Huan amisawlte akiang ahong tun un, "Baptispa Johan in, 'Hong pai dingpa na hi hia, midang hungaih lai ding ka hi uhia?' chi in na kiang ah kou a hon sawl," achi uhi.
english: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”

paite: Huaitak in Jesu'n, damloute, hipi veite, dawimatte tampi ahihdam a, mittaw tampite leng amit uh ahihvak hi.
english: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.

paite: Akiang uah, "Pai nawnta unla, thil na muh uleh na zak uh Johan va hilh un; mittawte mit ahong vakta, khebaite khe in apaita ua, phakte hihsiang in om ua, nangongte bil ahong vakta, misite kaihthoh in a-omta uh, azawngte'n tanchinhoih hilh atangta uh.
english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

paite: Huan kuapeuh ka tung a lung hihlouhna mu lou ahampha hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

paite: Johan sawltakte apai nung un Jesu'n mipite kiang ah Johan thu agen a, "Bang en ding a gamdai a paikhia na hi ua? Sialluang huih mut ling maw?
english: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

paite: Ahihkeileh, bang en ding pen a paikhia na hi ua? Puannem silh mi maw? Ngai un, puan thupi silh leh minuamsate kumpipate inn ah ei ve a-om uh.
english: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed and live delicately are in kings’ courts.

paite: Ahihkeileh, bang en ding pen in ahia na paikhiak uh? Zawlnei maw? Ahi tawk vo oi, ka hon chi ahi, amah zaw zawlnei sang a leng thupizaw ahi.
english: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

paite: 'En dih, ka thangkou na ma ah ka sawl ahi, ama'n na ma ah na lampi abawlkhol ding, chi a, atanchin kigelh, hiai mipa ahi.’
english: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

paite: Numei suan lak ah Johan sang a thupizaw a-om kei; himahleh Pathian lalgam a mineupen leng amah sang in athupizaw, ka hon chi ahi," achi hi.
english: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in God’s Kingdom is greater than he.”

paite: Huan mi tengteng leh siahkhonte'n huai azak un, Johan khut a baptisma tangsa ahih ziak un, Pathian siam atangsak uhi.
english: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.

paite: Pharisaite leh dan thei mite'n bel akiang a baptisma ana tang kei ua, amau a ding a Pathian in hoih dia asehsak adeih kei uhi.
english: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.

paite: Huchi in Jesu mah in, "Hiai khang bang toh ka teh diam aw? Bang toh kibang ahi ua?
english: “To what then should I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?

paite: Naupang dawr mun a tu a, 'Tamngai hon tumsak ung a, lam lou uchin a;' 'Suun ung a, nou lah kap tuan lou uchin a,' chi a kichituahte bang ahi uh.
english: They are like children who sit in the marketplace and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’

paite: Baptispa Johan ahong pai a, tanghou ane kei, uain leng adawn kei a nou, 'Dawi zawl ei ve,' na chi uhi.
english: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’

paite: Mihing Tapa ahong pai a, ane in adawn a, 'En dih uh, an haipa, uain haipa, siahkhon mite leh mikhialte lawm,' na chi zel uhi.
english: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’

paite: Himahleh pilna tuh atate tengteng in siam atan uhi," achi hi.
english: Wisdom is justified by all her children.”

paite: Pharisaite lak a mi khat in akiang a an ne ding in adeih hi. Huai Pharisai inn ah alut a, an a-um hi.
heading: Pharisai Simon Inn A Jesu Thaunilhna
english: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house and sat at the table.

paite: Ngai dih, huai khua a numei khat om in Pharisai inn ah an um in atu chih a theihtak in alabaster bawm in thaunamtui ahon tawi hi.
english: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.

paite: Anung ah akhepek bul ah kap kawm in adingh a, akhitui in akhepek asukawt a, asam in anul a, akhepek atawp a, thaunamtui anuh hi.
english: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

paite: Huan asampa Pharisai in huai amuh in, alungsim in, “Hiai mi zawlnei ahihleh akhoihnu numei kua ahia, mi bangchi ahia, theihtuaktak hi a, mikhial ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Simon, na kiang ah thu kam khat gen ding ka nei," chi in adawng hi. Ama'n, "Bang ahia, Sinsakpa?" achi hi.
english: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”

paite: Jesu'n, "Dangka leitawisak kuahiam in leibami nih anei a; khat in makhai zanga, khat in sawmnga aba uhi.
english: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

paite: Huan aditna ding anei kei ua, angaidam tuaktuak hi. Huai mite akua in amah a-itzaw dia?" achi hi.
english: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”

paite: Simon in, "Angaihdam tampen in hi in ka gingta," chi in adawng hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Na chi dik," achi hi.
english: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”

paite: Huan numei lam anga a, Simon kiang ah, "Hiai numei na mu hia? Na inn ah ka hong lut a, nang ka khepek silna ding tui na hon pe kei a, ama'n akhitui in ka khepek asukawt a, asam in anul hi.
english: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.

paite: Nang tawp himhim na hon tawp kei; ama'n ka hong lut nungsiah ka khepek tawp atawlnga kei hi.
english: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.

paite: Nang ka lutang ah thau na hon nilh kei a; ama'n ka khepek thaunamtui anilh hi.
english: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.

paite: Huaiziak in ka hon chi ahi, akhelhna tampi ngaihdam in a-omta; ama'n nakpi in a-it hi. Himahleh, ngaidam tawm in, neuchik in a-it," achi hi.
english: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.”

paite: Huai zoh in numei kiang ah, "Na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita," achi hi.
english: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”

paite: Huchi in an umpihte'n, "Mikhialte nangawn ngaidam kua ahia eita?" akichi uhi.
english: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”

paite: Numei kiang ah, "Na ginna in ahon hondam hi, khamuangtak in paita in," achi hi.
english: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”
